question: Does fixed overlapping tile inference repair the observed D03M3 proposal-reachability failure while leaving target-only FFA and SAM unchanged?

predecessor.single_change: Add four fixed 65%-width by 65%-height corner tiles to the unchanged full-frame proposal set; retain target-only FFA, SAM, thresholds and IoU gate.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed overlapping corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then rank their SAM-masked FFA descriptors together without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: SAM-mask-weighted mean of normalized 37x37 DINOv2 patch tokens inside the unmasked RGB box crop, followed by L2 normalization.
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to the three target FFA memories only; no sibling subtraction, fitted scale or threshold.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal and use the selected mask tight bbox.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider boxes enter only post-ranking proposal opportunity and tight-mask-box IoU evaluation.

decision_gate.interpretation: All three consumed D03 frames must contain a retained IoU-at-least-0.5 proposal and all three FFA top-one masks must reach IoU at least 0.5.

literature_motivation.use: Preserve the open-vocabulary detector and its multi-scale visual representation.

literature_motivation.source: Multi-scale tiling for pseudo-labeling in dense scene object detection
literature_motivation.use: Use overlapping image tiles to recover objects missed by standard full-frame GroundingDINO inference.

forbidden_after_freeze: change tile scale/count/offsets, caps, prompt, thresholds, FFA, memory, SAM or IoU gate
use provider truth to select a tile or proposal
claim consumed D03 posthoc evidence as fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This consumed D03 Development run can establish only whether fixed overlapping tile proposals repair the observed proposal-reachability failure. It cannot regain fresh-family authority or establish open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
